caption: JLD and learned baselines have complementary wins and failures. Each comparison shows its pristine reference thumbnail above two distorted photographs. Bold MOS identifies the higher-rated left image; blue metric marks agree with this ordering and orange slashed marks reverse it. JLD, DISTS and LPIPS-VGG each agree on two of four deliberately selected comparisons. JLD agrees on the upper noise-versus-pattern and quantisation-versus-block comparisons, and disagrees on the lower contrast-versus-impulse and patches-versus-block comparisons. Both baselines show the opposite pattern. These selected examples do not estimate accuracy. Fields use a shared warm colour scale and exclude the global output term, which remains included in the scalar decisions. MOS scales differ between datasets.
selection_rule: Columns are TID2013 and held-out KADID. First exclude each dataset reference used in fig4_qual. Top row: the next maximum human-score-gap comparison satisfying the fig4 rule (different distortion types, PSNR difference below 0.02 dB, the macro-named metric correct and both baselines wrong). Bottom row: exclude every already used reference and maximise the human-score gap among different distortion types with PSNR difference below 0.5 dB, the macro-named metric wrong and both baselines correct. A always has higher MOS. Resolve ties by lower PSNR gap then reference/A/B paths lexicographically.

presentation_revision: Removed agreement-rate and delta badges from a deliberately balanced example gallery; retained pair-level wins and failures.

iteration_review.iteration_1: Retained the four original pairs; moved each comparison verdict to a single aligned strip and made all tied counts explicit. Review: agreement colours need a key and the generic plot audit misreads photograph frames.
iteration_review.iteration_2: Added matching blue-equals and orange-not-equal key, retained 6 pt minimum type, and adopted grey Rectangle frames without chart axes. Review: replace the duplicated legend marks with explicit agree/disagree words.
iteration_review.iteration_3: Made agree/disagree key explicit, moved the global MOS direction to the footer and tightened the zero-delta label. Final visual review: even margins, matching baselines, no crossings or label collisions.
iteration_review.iteration_4: Use valid embedded Nimbus Sans TrueType outlines and the same-family delta glyph; final compare reviewed after the font fix.

table_crosscheck.result: Aggregate tables contain no selected-gallery pair rows. Pair MOS, PSNR and distances are checked directly against the original CSV rows, with selectors in score_sources.
